title: nf-core/contaminationqc pipeline - params.somalier_background schema
description: Previously extracted .somalier files used as additional candidate contamination sources and identity references (never reported as samples). They must have been extracted with the same sites file.

sample.errorMessage: Background sample name must be provided and may only contain letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'

somalier.errorMessage: Path to a .somalier file must be provided
